{
    "members": [
        {
            "class": "ImportManager",
            "doc": "\nCreates a FusionArchiveImportOptions object that imports a design from a Fusion archive format.\nThe creation of the FusionArchiveImportOptions object does not perform the import. You must pass\nthis object to one of the ImportManager import methods to perform the import. The FusionArchiveImportOptions\nobject supports the available options when importing from a Fusion archive format. This method only supports\nf3d files. For f3z files, you should use the DataFolder.uploadFile method.\nfilename : The filename or URL of the Fusion archive file to be imported. Only f3d files can be imported.\nFor f3z files, you should use the DataFolder.uploadFile method.\nThe created FusionArchiveImportOptions object or null if the creation failed.\n",
            "name": "createFusionArchiveImportOptions",
            "namespace": "adsk.core",
            "signature": "(filename: str) -> adsk.core.FusionArchiveImportOptions",
            "type": "function"
        },
        {
            "class": "ImportManager",
            "doc": "\nExecutes the import operation to import a file (of the format specified by the input ImportOptions object)\nto a new document.\nThis method does not support the DXF2DImportOptions or SVGImportOptions objects. Use ImportToTarget or\nImportToTarget2 for those types.\nimportOptions : An ImportOptions object that is created using one of the create methods on the ImportManager object. This\ndefines the type of file and any available options supported for that file type.\nReturns the newly created Document object or null if the creation failed.\nA new unnamed, unsaved document will be opened in Fusion as a result.\n",
            "name": "importToNewDocument",
            "namespace": "adsk.core",
            "signature": "(importOptions: ImportOptions) -> adsk.core.Document",
            "type": "function"
        },
        {
            "class": "ExportManager",
            "doc": "\nCreates an STEPExportOptions object that's used to export a design in STEP format. Creation\nof the STEPExportOptions object does not perform the export. You must pass this object to the\nExportManager.execute method to perform the export. The STEPExportOptions supports any available\noptions when exporting to STEP format.\nfilename : The filename of the STEP file to be created.\ngeometry : The geometry to export. Valid geometry for this is currently a Component object. This argument is optional\nand if not specified, it results in the root component and it entire contents being exported.\nThe created STEPExportOptions object or null if the creation failed.\n",
            "name": "createSTEPExportOptions",
            "namespace": "adsk.fusion",
            "signature": "(*args) -> adsk.fusion.STEPExportOptions",
            "type": "function"
        },
        {
            "class": "ExportManager",
            "doc": "\nCreates a STEPFlatPatternExportOptions object that's used to export a flat pattern in STEP format. Creation\nof the STEPFlatPatternExportOptions object does not perform the export. You must pass this object to the\nExportManager.execute method to perform the export.\nfilename : The filename of the STEP file to be created.\nflatPattern : The FlatPattern object to export.\nThe created STEPFlatPatternExportOptions object or null if the creation failed.\n",
            "name": "createSTEPExportOptionsForFlatPattern",
            "namespace": "adsk.fusion",
            "signature": "(filename: str, flatPattern: FlatPattern) -> adsk.fusion.STEPFlatPatternExportOptions",
            "type": "function"
        }
    ],
    "message": "API documentation query completed",
    "success": true
}
